explanation: Those who give testimony or confirm the truth about Jesus Christ through their experience with him.
Baptism, the symbol of cleansing from sin and consecration in faith.
Christ's death on the cross as an atonement for human sins.
The Holy Spirit who testifies to the truth and gives life to believers.
Eternal existence given by God through Jesus Christ, in contrast to death.
Actions or attitudes that break with God's will and separate humans from him.
People who have received a new identity and the right to be children of God through faith in Jesus.
